question: What mode of transmission especially leads to sharing in siddhi rather than otherwise?
premises: Transmission from mouth to mouth is specified.
This mode is emphasized as special.
Sharing in siddhi is contrasted with the alternative.
inference: Therefore mouth-to-mouth transmission especially brings a share in siddhi, otherwise not.
uncertainties: samānyathā is taken as indicating the contrary case.
plain_english: Especially from mouth to mouth one shares in siddhi; otherwise not.
